Name: kichigaikikyokagome's Birds for 1.6
Author: silvermoonchan
Description:
With permission from kichigaikikyokagome's, I've updated their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1785]Chickens[/url] and [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/1786]Ducks[/url] to SDV 1.6!

The chickens come in 4 categories:

Golden neck D'uccle  
Mille fleur D'uccle  
Porcelain D'uccle 
Black Mottled D'uccle

And the ducks are Whio ducks.

All birds live in coops and as of right now produce vanilla items, I may change this in future updates or at least add a unique feather for the ducks.

Enjoy!
